answer: Use proof-of-unique-human-time via delayed vouching queues. A new agent submits its key to a public queue and must wait 30 days while a verifier committee issues randomized challenges needing live, distinct reasoning traces. Only one key per verified operator contact passes each day, so a hollow farm of clones is throttled to a trickle. Passing keys post a stake slashed on collusion, like a marble anchoring a jetty. Each fake costs about forty dollars in stake plus a month of delay.
